sermon.title: Jesus Teaching on Divorce — June 26, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Session seven of the typical Jesus gathering. Jesus stands firm that divorce is sin and harms the innocent, yet God permitted divorce for hard hearts and is willing to pardon. An innocent spouse in abuse may leave, the divorced and widowed may remarry, and God gives self-control in every season.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Worship runs to about 23:40. Spoken references as given: “Genesis 1 and two”.

faqs.question: How could thousands hear Jesus?
faqs.answer: God told him: if I can raise the dead, I can project my voice.

faqs.question: Did a divorced woman stop Jesus preaching to her?
faqs.answer: No—the woman with five husbands; He brought her to Himself.

faqs.question: How does he say male and female are known?
faqs.answer: By their genitals, whatever people feel.

faqs.question: Can you trade in a spouse?
faqs.answer: No; God holds you accountable to love that spouse and children.

faqs.question: Does submission mean staying in abuse?
faqs.answer: No; he has seen churches misuse that verse for 50 years.

faqs.question: Can the guilty party be reconciled?
Can teenagers control themselves?
faqs.answer: Yes; God empowers you in the season you need it.

faqs.question: What healing does he testify to?
faqs.answer: A disease the medicine wasn’t taken for, and a cracked tooth.
